::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

<!-- No caption here. This include is wrapped in a Quarto figure div in
     ch10-inversion-recovery.qmd, which supplies the caption so the figure
     is numbered and cross-referenceable like every other figure in the
     book. Adding a <p class="caption"> back would double it up. -->

<!-- This is the first qmrust figure on the page that needs the T1 map, so it
     loads data-t1map.js and ir-shared.js. It does NOT load figures.css,
     plotly-cartesian.min.js, or qmrust_wasm.js -- includes/fig-t1-equations.qmd
     sits earlier in ch10 and has already pulled those in. Loading
     qmrust_wasm.js twice is a SyntaxError, not just waste: the file opens with
     a top-level `let wasm_bindgen`, and redeclaring that kills the second
     script. Order on the page is fig-t1-equations -> this -> fig-qmrlab-demo. -->

<div class="qmrust-figure">

<p id="m-status" hidden style="font-size:12px;color:#a11;margin:0 0 10px"></p>

<div class="qmrust-toggle" role="group" aria-label="What the figure shows">
  <button id="m-btn-mz"  type="button" aria-pressed="true">Magnetization</button>
  <button id="m-btn-sig" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Signal</button>
</div>

<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;overflow-x:auto">
  <div id="m-curves" style="flex:1 1 430px;min-width:400px"></div>
  <div id="m-maps"   style="flex:0 0 250px"></div>
</div>


</div>

<script src="interactive/data-t1map.js"></script>
<script src="interactive/ir-shared.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var TNR = "Times New Roman";
  var CFGP = { showLink: false, displayModeBar: false, responsive: true };

  /* TI where white and grey matter are exactly equal and opposite. Solves
     exp(-TI/T1_wm) + exp(-TI/T1_gm) = 1 for the calibrated T1 values 0.90 and
     1.35 s, i.e. Mz_wm(TI) = -Mz_gm(TI) = +0.1397. Their nulls bracket it, at
     0.69*0.90 = 0.62 s and 0.69*1.35 = 0.94 s. Hard-coded rather than solved at
     runtime so the caption's numbers cannot drift away from the drawing; if the
     ANCHOR table in ir-shared.js is retuned, recompute this. */
  var TI_FIXED = 0.7592;

  var TI_MAX = 5, NTI = 400;        // TI samples for the drawn curves
  var NBIN = 100;                   // T1 bins for the image lookup
  var T1_LO = 0.05, T1_HI = 5.0;

  var MODES = {
    mz:  { method: "complex",   yTitle: "M<sub>z</sub>",   zmin: -1, zmax: 1,
           cbar: "M<sub>z</sub>", label: "Magnetization" },
    sig: { method: "magnitude", yTitle: "|M<sub>z</sub>|", zmin:  0, zmax: 1,
           cbar: "|S|",           label: "Signal" }
  };
  var mode = "mz";                  // opens on magnetization

  var tiGrid = IR.linspace(0.001, TI_MAX, NTI);
  var curves = {};                  // mode -> [y per tissue]
  var binVal = {};                  // mode -> Float64Array(NBIN), value at TI_FIXED
  var map = null;

  /* One forward() call per tissue per mode for the curves, then one per T1 bin
     per mode for the image. Because TI is fixed here there is no TI axis to
     tabulate -- the image needs a single value per bin, not a bin x TI table,
     so this is far cheaper than the slider figure's precompute. */
  function precompute() {
    Object.keys(MODES).forEach(function (m) {
      var meth = MODES[m].method;
      var cfgCurves = IR.recipe(tiGrid, meth);
      curves[m] = IR.TISSUES.map(function (t) {
        return IR.forward(cfgCurves, t.T1, 1.0, -2.0);
      });
      /* qMRust rejects a protocol with fewer than three inversion times --
         the model has three free parameters, so a shorter list is not a
         fittable protocol and it returns "invalid protocol". Only the value
         at TI_FIXED is wanted here, so the list is padded out to the minimum
         length and index 0 is read back. */
      var cfgOne = IR.recipe([TI_FIXED, TI_FIXED + 1, TI_FIXED + 2], meth);
      var vals = new Float64Array(NBIN);
      for (var b = 0; b < NBIN; b++) {
        var T1 = T1_LO + (T1_HI - T1_LO) * (b + 0.5) / NBIN;
        vals[b] = IR.forward(cfgOne, T1, 1.0, -2.0)[0];
      }
      binVal[m] = vals;
    });
  }

  /** The image at TI_FIXED, voxel by voxel, read out of the per-bin table. */
  function image() {
    var vals = binVal[mode], out = new Array(map.T1map.length);
    for (var v = 0; v < map.T1map.length; v++) {
      var t1 = map.T1map[v];
      if (!map.mask[v] || !Number.isFinite(t1) || t1 <= 0) { out[v] = null; continue; }
      var b = Math.floor((t1 - T1_LO) / (T1_HI - T1_LO) * NBIN);
      out[v] = vals[Math.max(0, Math.min(NBIN - 1, b))];
    }
    return out;
  }

  function drawCurves() {
    var M = MODES[mode];
    var traces = IR.TISSUES.map(function (t, i) {
      var name = "T<sub>1</sub> = " + t.T1.toFixed(2) + " s (" + t.label + ")";
      return { x: tiGrid, y: curves[mode][i], mode: "lines", name: name, text: name,
               hoverinfo: "x+y+text" };
    });
    Plotly.react("m-curves", traces, {
      width: 430, height: 330, margin: { l: 55, r: 8, b: 50, t: 10 },
      xaxis: IR.axis({ title: { text: "Inversion Time – TI (s)",
                                font: { family: TNR, size: 15 } } }),
      // Held fixed across both modes on purpose: rescaling would hide the fold.
      yaxis: IR.axis({ title: { text: M.yTitle, font: { family: TNR, size: 15 } },
                       range: [-1.05, 1.05],
                       zeroline: true, zerolinecolor: "#bbb", zerolinewidth: 1 }),
      legend: { x: 1, y: 0.02, xanchor: "right", yanchor: "bottom",
                font: { family: TNR, size: 11 }, bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.75)" },
      shapes: [{ type: "line", x0: TI_FIXED, x1: TI_FIXED, yref: "paper", y0: 0, y1: 1,
                 line: { color: "#444", width: 1.5, dash: "dot" } }],
      plot_bgcolor: "white", paper_bgcolor: "white"
    }, CFGP);
  }

  function drawMap() {
    var M = MODES[mode];
    var blank = { showgrid: false, zeroline: false, showticklabels: false, ticks: "" };
    Plotly.react("m-maps", [{
      type: "heatmap", z: IR.cropGrid(IR.grid(image(), map.nx, map.ny, 0, 1), map.bbox),
      colorscale: [[0, "rgb(0,0,0)"], [1, "rgb(255,255,255)"]],
      zmin: M.zmin, zmax: M.zmax,
      colorbar: { title: { text: M.cbar, side: "top", font: { family: TNR, size: 13 } },
                  thickness: 7, len: 0.72 },
      hovertemplate: "%{z:.2f}<extra></extra>"
    }], {
      width: 250, height: 330, margin: { t: 30, r: 2, b: 6, l: 2 },
      annotations: [{ text: M.label + " at TI = " + TI_FIXED.toFixed(2) + " s",
                      x: 0.5, y: 1.10, xref: "paper", yref: "paper",
                      showarrow: false, font: { family: TNR, size: 15 } }],
      xaxis: Object.assign({ domain: [0, 0.88] }, blank),
      yaxis: Object.assign({ domain: [0, 1], scaleanchor: "x" }, blank),
      plot_bgcolor: "white", paper_bgcolor: "white"
    }, CFGP);
  }

  function setMode(m) {
    mode = m;
    $("m-btn-mz").setAttribute("aria-pressed",  String(m === "mz"));
    $("m-btn-sig").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(m === "sig"));
    drawCurves();
    drawMap();
  }

  function fail(msg, e) {
    var el = $("m-status");
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.hidden = false;
    if (e) { console.error(e); }
  }

  window.addEventListener("load", function () {
    if (typeof Plotly === "undefined") { fail("Plotly failed to load."); return; }
    wasm_bindgen({ module_or_path: "interactive/qmrust_wasm_bg.wasm" }).then(function () {
      setTimeout(function () {
        precompute();
        map = IR.loadT1Map();
        setMode("mz");
        $("m-btn-mz").addEventListener("click",  function () { setMode("mz"); });
        $("m-btn-sig").addEventListener("click", function () { setMode("sig"); });
      }, 20);
    }).catch(function (e) {
      fail("qMRust failed to start: " + e, e);
    });
  });
})();
</script>

:::
